#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
using ll = long long;
using pii = pair<int, int>;
using pll = pair<ll, ll>;
using ldb = double;

template<typename T>
inline void ckmn(T& a, T b) { a = std::min(a, b); }

template<typename T>
inline void ckmx(T& a, T b) { a = std::max(a, b); }

inline void rd(int& x) { scanf("%d", &x); }

template<typename T1, typename T2>
inline void rd(pair<T1, T2>& p) { rd(p.first); rd(p.second); }

template<typename T>
inline void rd(vector<T>& v) { for (auto& x : v) rd(x); }

inline void re(vector<int> E[], int m, bool dir = false) {

        E[u].push_back(v);
        if (!dir) E[v].push_back(u);

template<typename T>
inline void re(vector<pair<int, T>> E[], int m, bool dir = false) {
    for (int i = 0, u, v; i < m; ++i) {
        T w;
        rd(u, v, w);
        E[u].emplace_back(v, w);
        if (!dir) E[v].emplace_back(u, w);

int mod;

inline int add(int a, int b) { a += b; return a >= mod ? a - mod : a; }
inline void ckadd(int& a, int b) { a = add(a, b); }
inline int sub(int a, int b) { a -= b; return a < 0 ? a + mod : a; }
inline void cksub(int& a, int b) { a = sub(a, b); }
inline int mul(int a, int b) { return (ll)a * b % mod; }
inline void ckmul(int& a, int b) { a = mul(a, b); }
inline int powmod(int x, int k) {
    int ans = 1;
    for (; k; k >>= 1, ckmul(x, x))
        if (k & 1) ckmul(ans, x);
    return ans;
}
inline int inv(int x) { return powmod(x, mod - 2); }

const int N = 505;
int blok[N], sum[N];

inline int c2(int x) { return (ll)x * (x + 1) / 2 % mod; }

int dp[N][N], ways[N][N];

const int M = 1050;
int F[M], I[M];

inline int binom(int n, int k) {
    if (k < 0 || k > n) return 0;
    return mul(F[n], mul(I[k], I[n - k]));
}

inline void calc() {
    F[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < M; ++i) F[i] = mul(F[i - 1], i);
    I[M - 1] = inv(F[M - 1]);
    for (int i = M - 2; ~i; --i) I[i] = mul(I[i + 1], i + 1);
}

int main() {
    int n, m;
    rd(n, m, mod);
    calc();

    blok[0] = 1;
    for (int x = 1; x <= m; ++x) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= x; ++i) {
            int coef = mul(blok[i - 1], mul(blok[x - i], binom(x - 1, i - 1)));
            blok[x] = add(blok[x], coef);
            int term1 = mul(add(c2(i - 1), c2(x - i)), coef);
            int term2 = mul(sum[i - 1], mul(mul(blok[x - i], binom(x - 1, i - 1)), x + 1));
            int term3 = mul(sum[x - i], mul(mul(blok[i - 1], binom(x - 1, i - 1)), x + 1));
            sum[x] = add(sum[x], add(term1, add(term2, term3)));
        }
        blok[x] = mul(blok[x], x + 1);
    }

    ways[0][0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; ++j) {
            for (int sz = 1; sz <= i; ++sz) {
                int coef = mul(blok[sz], binom(m - i + sz, sz));
                ways[i][j] = add(ways[i][j], mul(ways[i - sz][j - 1], coef));
                int term1 = mul(ways[i - sz][j - 1], mul(sum[sz], binom(m - i + sz, sz)));
                int term2 = mul(dp[i - sz][j - 1], coef);
                dp[i][j] = add(dp[i][j], add(term1, term2));
            }
        }
    }

    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
        int zero = n - m;
        int lef = zero - (i - 1);
        if (lef >= 0) {
            ans = add(ans, mul(dp[m][i], binom(i + 1 + lef, lef)));
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}
